course_name_original: Antenne E Dispositivi Per La Comunicazione Digitale
course_name_en: Antennas And Devices For Digital Communication

learning_outcomes.text: The student must demonstrate adequate knowledge of the operating principles and characteristics of the most common antennas used in digital communication, describing their radiative properties and specific applications. The student must also demonstrate a sufficient understanding of the characteristics of a circuit for transmission/reception and those of a far-field and near-field link.
The student must demonstrate the ability to apply, through the description of appropriate procedures, elementary design schemes for the examined antennas according to the most common applications.

syllabus_topics: The antenna as an essential tool in digital communications and sensing
Active, passive, and power harvesting tags
Narrowband, broadband, and ultra-broadband antenna systems for telephony, digital transmission, telemetry (including biomedical), biosensors, smart home, and smart industry
Internal and external antennas for telephony, digital transmission, digital media, IoT, sensing and monitoring, and body-centric communication
Analysis and design of planar and printed antennas
Devices for transmission and reception (signal generation, amplification, filtering and matching)
Immunity devices: balun, choke and ferrite devices
Electromagnetic properties and modeling of the diffusive behavior of the human body
Systems that use the human body as a transmission channel
Analysis and design of antennas using advanced numerical tools
Elements of regulation for the safe dimensioning of connection systems
Laboratory experiences: anechoic chamber, antenna gain measurement, radiation pattern measurement
institution: Università degli Studi di Napoli Federico II
degree: Laurea in Ingegneria Elettronica (L-8, Classe delle lauree in Ingegneria dell'informazione)
